the Sahara noun

also Sahara, Saharan, Sahara Desert

modern

M-O s.v. Sahara desert (Egger)

loca dēserta Sahariāna

Plural, the Saharan wastes. Desfontaines (1798) wrote dēsertum Sahara dictum, the desert called Sahara (M-O). The ancients knew its peoples, the Garamantes and Gaetulians, but had no name for the whole.

    modern · M-O s.v. Saharan (Egger) · Declension on Wiktionary
